description: The 20V MAX* Lithium Hand Vac is perfect for handy cleaning anywhere and any time, especially in homes with pets. The cyclonic action and strong suction of the 20V MAX* Lithium Hand Vac makes cleanup easy and fast. The included Pet Brush is ideal for cleaning up stubborn pet hair. The 20V MAX* Lithium Hand Vac has a charging station that keeps it at the ready and also provides a base for storage. Cyclonic action spins dirt away from the filter to help maintain performance and a 3-stage filtration system prevents dust and debris from escaping. It also has an easy-to-empty, washable bowl and filter for thorough cleaning. *Maximum initial battery voltage (measured without a workload) is 20 volts. Nominal voltage is 18. Charge Duration 4 hrs.
